title: Palestinian tech goes to Silicon Valley
gist: A World Bank TechStart mission brought a Palestinian tech delegation and nine IPSD II-backed startups to Silicon Valley to meet Google, Apple, NVIDIA, AWS and others, pitching for investment rather than sympathy. The two projects have mobilized over $62 million in private capital, and follow-up pilots and partnerships are under discussion.

themes.theme: Palestinian tech as a commercial proposition

insights.claim: Palestinian tech founders pitched Silicon Valley as businesses seeking investment rather than sympathy, emphasizing technically competitive, bilingual engineers with international client experience and a strong cost-quality proposition.
insights.speaker: @worldbank
insights.so_what: Positions Palestine as a potential nearshore/offshore engineering talent source.
